fields.description: Denormalised so a settlement list renders without a second fetch per row.
fields.label: Partner Name

fields.description: The partner's own Customer, snapshotted from the partner at settlement time.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: The statement period this settlement covers. Reporting metadata only - the invoices actually covered are the rows in the table below, never a date range re-evaluated later.
fields.label: From Date

fields.description: The partner's own statement or transfer number. What a human matches this settlement against when the figures are queried months later.
fields.label: Statement Reference

fields.description: The sum of each covered invoice's OUTSTANDING amount, not its grand total. Computed from the rows below; never typed.
fields.label: Gross Amount

fields.description: Derived: commission over gross. NOT the partner's live rate and not any invoice's snapshot - it is what this settlement actually worked out at, which is the number to compare against the statement when a partner disputes it.
fields.label: Effective Commission Rate (%)

fields.description: Editable, deliberately. The stored rate seeds it, but the document being reconciled is the partner's own statement - when the two disagree, the statement wins. Booked as a debit to the partner's commission expense account so the invoices close in full.
fields.label: Commission Amount

fields.description: Anything the statement carries that is neither takings nor commission - a refund the partner clawed back, a rounding difference. Debited alongside the commission. May be negative.
fields.label: Adjustment

fields.description: Where the adjustment is booked. Separate from the commission account on purpose: a clawback or a rounding difference is not commission, and merging them makes the commission figure unusable for reporting. Falls back to the commission account when blank.
fields.label: Adjustment Account

fields.description: What actually landed in the bank. received + commission + adjustment must equal gross, or the settlement is refused.
fields.label: Received Amount

fields.description: The bank account the transfer landed in. Must NOT be a cashier's cash account: the money never passed through a drawer, and crediting one would tell that cashier to hand over cash they never received.
fields.label: Received In

fields.description: Set instead of Payment Entry when the settlement covers orders billed to the partner's app customers (Bill the App Customer). A Payment Entry has ONE party, so it cannot clear invoices spread over many customers; this Journal Entry credits each customer's invoice in one balanced document.
fields.label: Journal Entry

fields.description: Stored rather than counted per row, so a settlement list does not fetch every child table.
fields.label: Invoice Count

fields.description: Makes a retry after a timeout return this settlement instead of paying the partner's account down twice.
fields.label: Idempotency Key
